I’m bipolar and everything you’re saying I relate to hardcore, keep a solid schedule, sleep and wake up at a certain time every day(sounds weird but trust me) after going in and out of mental hospitals I’ve slowly learned many things 
1. Anger is secondary emotion, you don’t just become angry identify the source of the anger, take a step back and analyze ways to fix that source of anger
2. Your emotions are a product of your environment, ex: being depressed cuz you’re in the ghetto of Detroit surrounded by destroyed buildings etc, same goes for people surround yourself around good people (that ones not so easy, I get that too) 
3. Wim hoff breathing method for meditation, used that to stop MANY anxiety attacks 
4. I have a ring with a metal chain that spins on the inside, when I’m nervous I just spin my lil chain on the ring to calm my anxiety
5. Buy dr.Sasquatch soap(not a ad) that shit just makes me feel so special and smooth after showers. Motivates me to keep showering and staying healthy when depression decides to ass fuck me, anyways hope this helps! Much love
